degradation_rule: When data is unavailable, use null/inconclusive and document gaps.
evidence_rule: evidence should map audit field names (e.g. "audit.python_file_count") to lists of strings citing file paths or commands used. Example: {"audit.python_file_count": ["Found 5 .py files in target_repo/src"], "audit.dependency_count": ["Counted from target_repo/pyproject.toml"]}
